mapper.select: select * from oa_meeting_room order by id desc
mapper.insert: insert into oa_meeting_room(room_name, capacity, location, equipment, status) values(#{roomName}, #{capacity}, #{location}, #{equipment}, #{status})
mapper.update: update oa_meeting_room set room_name = #{roomName}, capacity = #{capacity}, location = #{location}, equipment = #{equipment}, status = #{status} where id = #{id}
